chatPanel.contextDerived:

modelForm.modelNamePlaceholder: Model name as the provider exposes it

promptProfile.fullHint: The complete system prompt, with all guardrails and examples. Recommended for large/capable models.
promptProfile.lightHint: A condensed system prompt (core rules + tool/skill list only). Use for models where shorter prompts save tokens/latency without hurting reliability.

orchestratorPolicy.directHint: The main agent reads, searches and does the task itself, and calls a helper only for an auxiliary job too large for its own context: full coverage of a huge file, condensing a large log, research across several web sources. Under both options the main agent makes every change to the project; plan mode still blocks writes and commands, and edit mode still asks you to confirm.
orchestratorPolicy.delegateHint: The main agent hands auxiliary work to helpers by default (reading or summarising long documents, extracting parts of a file, condensing logs, researching the web) and keeps its own context for the task. Helpers run on the project's worker model, so pointing that at a smaller model saves tokens. The main agent still makes every change itself: helpers return data, never edits.

modelForm.supportsThinkingHint: Keep this off unless the model documentation explicitly says it supports thinking or reasoning parameters.
modelForm.requiresSingleSystemMessageHint: Enable only if this model's chat template rejects requests with more than one system-role message (reported as "system message must be at the beginning"). GilzaBots will merge all system content into one leading message before sending it to this model.
modelForm.numCtxHint: The context window requested for this model. Leave empty for Auto: hosted models use the window their provider reports; self-hosted Ollama models use a conservative default (8192 on this machine, 65536 on another host), since there num_ctx sizes the memory the server allocates. When the provider reports no window, GilzaBots applies no limit of its own. A project can still override this value for its own use under Advanced settings.
modelForm.numCtxError: Context window must be a positive whole number.
modelForm.modelParamsHint: Optional inference and sampling settings configured for this model. Leave empty to use provider defaults.
modelForm.temperatureError: Temperature must be a number between 0.0 and 2.0.
modelForm.maxTokensError: Max tokens must be a positive whole number.
modelForm.seedError: Seed must be a non-negative whole number.
modelForm.topPError: Top P must be a number between 0.0 and 1.0.
modelForm.topKError: Top K must be a positive whole number.
modelForm.minPError: Min P must be a number between 0.0 and 1.0.
modelForm.frequencyPenaltyError: Frequency penalty must be a number between -2.0 and 2.0.
modelForm.presencePenaltyError: Presence penalty must be a number between -2.0 and 2.0.
modelForm.repetitionPenaltyError: Repetition penalty must be a non-negative number.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.intro: Connect GilzaBots to external services through MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Their tools become tools of the chat agent. By default every call asks for your approval and shows its arguments. Only connect servers you trust: tool descriptions and results come from the server.
connectors.fieldIdHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - or _. Tools appear as mcp__<id>__<tool>.
connectors.approvalAlwaysHint: Every call shows an approval prompt with its arguments, even in auto mode. Recommended for services that act on your accounts.
connectors.approvalModeHint: Calls follow the chat mode like native tools: auto runs them, edit asks, plan blocks them.
connectors.oauthHint: GilzaBots registers itself with the server's authorization server. Only fill in a client id if the service requires an app you registered with it.
